scope: Checked-in examples/**/rtl/**/*.sv and .v, including vendored DUTs. Testbenches, formal harnesses, generated HDL and gate netlists are outside this common DUT lint gate and are built by their respective runners. Mutations are deliberate negative fixtures, not production configurations.
configuration_policy: Every declared DUT module at defaults plus explicit normal parameter variants; not exhaustive Cartesian enumeration. Embedded instance parameters elaborate with their parent top.
